BiblicalUsage: Bavvai is named once. He is the ruler of half of Keilah who repairs another measure of the wall with his men.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the wall was built measure by measure by men like Bavvai, and every measure is remembered because every builder mattered.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
